verdict.rationale: Mercury's own pages say you can "instantly spin up as many virtual cards as you need" for any purpose, including ad spend and contractors, with card limits and spend controls. The Cards API changelog confirms virtual card issuance, spending limits and lifecycle control. A 5-year customer independently reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of locking a card to a single vendor or merchant, beyond general spend controls.
